subject: Sequester edge split: expansion ask, term update and ops runway
messages:
From: Sara Lu <sara.lu@bioclarity.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@bioclarity.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sequester edge: private expansion & renewal

Hi Karthik,

As we approach our 12/15 renewal, we're planning a targeted expansion for Bioclarity's analytics environment. Summary: we need an isolated VPC for a new EU analytics cluster, two additional on-prem-like clusters for model serving in the EU region (one active, one standby), and stricter network sequestering for PHI processing.

Key asks:
- Updated pricing for adding 2 clusters + a standby reserve (estimate: 200K–300K ARR delta)
- Proposed term options (extend current term vs. add amendment)
- Timeline for provisioning and SOC2 evidence needed by procurement

I've attached an appendix with compliance bullet points and a rough procurement timeline (attached: RFP-sequester-edge-appendix.docx).

Can we get an initial commercial/ops plan and a proposed amendment by next week? Our procurement lead (cc'd) needs the high-level numbers to start internal approvals.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lu
VP, Cloud Data & Integrations
Bioclarity
[attachment: RFP-sequester-edge-appendix.docx (DOCX, 84KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Lu <sara.lu@bioclarity.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequester edge: private expansion & renewal

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and appendix. We're aligned on the scope but need a couple of sizing numbers to make the commercial proposal accurate: expected qps for inference at peak, average sequence length (tokens) for analytics pipelines, and whether the standby cluster can be async-warm or must be hot.

Operationally we'll likely propose:
- 1 x EU isolated VPC environment (new)
- 2 x additional serving clusters (NVIDIA-class GPUs) + 1 x standby cluster (policy: warm standby by default)
- Phased rollout: sandbox → staging (1 week) → production cutover (2–3 weeks)

I'll loop Monica for pricing and Markus for the deployment runbook. Monica — can you draft two options (12‑month amendment and 36‑month term extension) with ballpark TCV? Markus — please flag any constraints for air-gapped support and KMS requirements for Bioclarity.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Sequester edge: pricing & amendment options (draft)

Karthik — initial commercial thoughts below (draft; will refine after we get Sara's sizing reply). Attaching a draft amendment (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf) with placeholders.

Option A — 12 month amendment (short-term, higher unit price)
- Add: 2 serving clusters + 1 standby (EU)
- One-time seeding & provisioning: $38,000
- Monthly consumption uplift: $28,000 (token-based and reserved GPU pool)
- Estimated 12-month TCV delta: ~ $410k

Option B — 36 month term extension (committed pricing, lower unit cost)
- Same footprint as above
- One-time seeding & provisioning: $25,000 (discounted)
- Monthly consumption uplift: $19,000
- Estimated 36-month TCV: ~ $825k (lower effective per-month)

Compliance & procurement notes:
- SOC2/ISO artifacts: provide SOC2 Type II attestation + network segmentation checklist (we have these in the security vault)
- KMS: support HSM-backed keys; need customer KMS configuration prior to cutover
- SLA: propose 99.95% for dedicated clusters; standby will have defined RTO of 15 minutes when warm

Attachments: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (amendment template, placeholders)

I recommend pushing Option B as the preferred commercial for predictable economics, but offer Option A if procurement is wary of long-term commitments. Happy to jump on a call to walk through numbers.

- Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (PDF, 230KB)]

From: Sara Lu <sara.lu@bioclarity.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bioclarity.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequester edge: pricing & amendment options (draft)

Thanks Monica — the options make sense. A few clarifications from procurement:
- Procurement prefers a 36-month commitment if unit economics are clearly better; they need the DocuSign-ready amendment and a one-page commercial summary to route to legal.
- SOC2 Type II report is required by 12/01 for our audit window — can you confirm you can provide the cert + relevant control mappings for data residency?
- We'll submit a soft PO to hold sloting while legal reviews.

Also: can the standby cluster be configured as async-warm (cold start < 10 minutes) instead of hot? That would push us to Option B more comfortably.

Attaching the PO placeholder: PO_Bioclarity_8742.pdf

Sara
Sara Lu
VP, Cloud Data & Integrations
Bioclarity
[attachment: PO_Bioclarity_8742.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Lu <sara.lu@bioclarity.com>, Procurement <procurement@bioclarity.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequester edge: pricing & amendment options (draft)

Sara / Procurement team — great, we're aligned. Next steps and owners: 

1) Commercial deliverables (Monica) — DocuSign-ready amendment (Option B as primary) + 1-page commercial summary by EOD Friday 11/27.
2) Security artifacts (Markus) — SOC2 Type II export & control mapping document by 12/01; will include notes on network segmentation and KMS flows.
3) Provisioning runbook & timeline (Markus) — rough 4-week runway from signed amendment; will include sandbox/staging/production milestones.
4) Procurement — Sara to confirm PO sloting; we can hold a provisioning window once DocuSign is returned.

Logistics: first kickoff call suggested Thursday 11/26 09:00 CET / 00:00 PST. I'm including a shared drive link for the amendment draft and runbook: https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/solutions/bioclarity/AMENDMENT-DRAFT.

I'll prepare a short internal checklist for any legal redlines we've seen historically on private/VPC amendments (cust KMS, data deletion clauses, export controls).

Thanks — we'll target the timelines you flagged.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
